releases.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: emergency truncation is now opt-in and sticky (compress.emergencyTruncation, default off) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/486
* fix: harden sticky truncation (post-#486 review: persistence, override cascade, object outputs, fork inheritance) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/488
* release v1.18.5 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/487


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/compare/v1.18.4...v1.18.5

## What's Changed
* feat: image archive — folded ranges keep re-readable image pointers instead of dropping pixels (#478) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/479
* release v1.18.4 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/480


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/compare/v1.18.3...v1.18.4

## What's Changed
* docs: point OpenCode 2.x users to billion-context by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/441
* feat(ci): one-click release workflow by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/443
* fix: keep quality-gate rejection concise — strip internal details, log full diagnostics (#444) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/447
* fix: decompress.toFile exports original text, not the summary (#445) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/448
* fix: verify source-message availability before committing decompression (#446) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/449
* fix: yield to billion-context native mode via action-time env re-check (#405) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/406
* docs: add new QQ group 1108730198, retain original 1056132097 marked full by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/450
* docs: compact two-line QQ group format, moved to top of README by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/451
* fix: respect user decisions on permission.acp_status in host config write (#457, #465) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/466
* fix: bound overheadErrorLogged Set in truncate-tools (#461) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/473
* fix: one-click release heals package-lock.json version drift instead of failing by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/474
* docs(agents): codify OpenCode V2 -> billion-context migration + triage rule by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/471
* release v1.18.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/475

## New Contributors
* @github-actions[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/475

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/compare/v1.18.2...v1.18.3

## What's Changed
* fix: normalize single Windows path separators in protectedFilePatterns by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/403
* promote: stable v1.18.1 — sync stable tag with latest by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/433
* fix: strip leaked bare ACP refs from completed assistant text (#431) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/432
* perf: arm compression plans from nudges by @frozenranger in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/437
* release: v1.18.2 — strip leaked bare ACP refs (#431) + Windows path protection fix (#402) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/440

## New Contributors
* @frozenranger made their first contribution in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/437

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/compare/v1.18.1...v1.18.2

## What's Changed
* docs: add paper preprint v0.2 (EN+ZH) + README links by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/394
* fix: restore throw-based abort for /acp subcommands (#398) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/399
* fix: concise quality-gate rejection message (issue #396) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/397
* release: v1.18.1 — paper preprint v0.2 into the repo (docs only) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/pull/401


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ranxianglei/opencode-acp/compare/v1.18.0...v1.18.1

issues.title: [Bug]: Growth nudges ignore minContextLimit and fire below it
Protected-message exemption inflates the incompressible context floor: per-compression reasoning is never reclaimable (~83.5% of measured residual)
Long-conversation scoped compaction produces "gap-residue" orphaned messages; recommend an orphan reclamation / defragmentation mechanism. | 长会话范围压缩产生'缝隙残留'孤儿消息，建议孤儿回收/碎片整理机制
fix: close final OpenCode V2 lifecycle, projection, and artifact verification gaps
For new version release only | 发布新版本专用
